title: job status
description: Response of POST /jobs and GET /jobs/{id} (F23): one heavy job (plan, siting, replan) in the process pool. Identical inputs attach to the running or finished job with the same hash. Queue cap, timeout and rate limits: config/backend.yaml compute.*, limits.*.

stage.description: stage now running; null when queued or finished

stages_done.description: finished stages in order; their files are already readable under result_url

result_url.description: results/{hash}/ base URL for the loader (dataUrl(path, mode, base)); set once the first stage is done

attached.description: true when identical inputs attached to a running or finished job
